commands.command: git bundle verify <each of five external private bundles>; fetch each into a disposable bare repository; git fsck --full --no-reflogs --connectivity-only
commands.summary: All five bundles passed integrity, disposable-fetch and connectivity checks. SHA-256 values, exact byte sizes, advertised refs, ref-inventory digests and reachable commit counts are recorded in the preservation manifest. The additive integrated-source all-refs bundle contains every one of 65 checkout refs with identical OIDs; no previous bundle was overwritten.

commands.command: Independent raw Git-object/source-manifest and extracted/published provenance SHA-256 reconciliation
commands.summary: All 1,048 immutable S2 source entries (853 Core, 194 Workbench, 1 historical archive) were reconciled to source, extraction and publication dispositions. No unexplained missing path, mismatch, duplicate S2 ownership or Core source copied into Workbench was found. Per-path hashes and exceptions are in the machine-readable reconciliation report.
ForgeWireLabs/repopact-core main was 7d761f6733b1de5078d08bc64ea076cf10cee58e before implementation and remained at that revision before publication.

Diagnostic run with the global Python/PATH selected repopact-engine 3.1.0.dev1 against the 3.1.3.dev1 package: 156 tests, 6 failures, 1 error, 2 skips. All seven failures/errors were the same engine-version mismatch; no repository version was changed.

commands.summary: Three findings in each tree; normalized redacted rule/path/line signatures are identical. They are inherited private-key detector matches in negative-test/parser material, with no new tree finding. Raw redacted reports remain outside the repository.

limitations: Git bundles preserve Git objects and refs, not hosted issues/comments, pull requests/reviews, discussions, release assets, branch protections/rulesets, Actions configuration/history or hosted artifacts. Current Core and Workbench API checks report Actions disabled and zero workflow runs; that does not establish that other hosted metadata never existed.
The disabled former personal-repository remote was not accessed; its current hosted state was not checked.

The original dirty WI073 checkout remains outside this worktree, with its two tracked modifications and three untracked files preserved separately. Git bundles do not contain that uncommitted content; no WI073 files were copied.
The three Gitleaks matches are pre-existing negative-test/parser patterns identical to the published baseline. Their raw redacted reports are stored outside the repository.
